why_boundary: Zero tests the lower numeric boundary
expected_behavior: Define policy: suggested default is to reject zero as a non-expense; do not include it in totals or unusual-spending checks.

why_boundary: Negative amount tests lower-bound validation
expected_behavior: Reject negative expenses unless refunds are explicitly supported; do not silently reduce monthly expense totals.

why_boundary: Very large value may exceed numeric or storage limits
expected_behavior: Reject amounts outside the supported range with a clear validation error; never overflow or corrupt totals.

why_boundary: Amount is just below twice the average
expected_behavior: Do not flag; the amount is not more than twice the average.

why_boundary: Amount is exactly twice the average
expected_behavior: Do not flag; the stated threshold is strictly more than twice the average.

why_boundary: Amount is just above twice the average
expected_behavior: Flag as unusual when the average is an eligible baseline for the same category and currency.

why_boundary: Null amount cannot contribute to a total
expected_behavior: Require an amount and show a validation error; do not save or aggregate the incomplete expense.

why_boundary: Empty currency makes grouping and comparison ambiguous
expected_behavior: Require a supported currency; show a validation error and do not aggregate the expense.

why_boundary: Optional note is absent
expected_behavior: Accept the expense with an empty note; note absence must not affect totals or unusual-spending checks.

why_boundary: Locale-formatted text may be ambiguous as a numeric input
expected_behavior: Parse only if the active locale makes the format unambiguous; otherwise show a validation error rather than guessing.

why_boundary: Excess fractional precision may be rounded or lost
expected_behavior: Enforce the supported precision for the currency and communicate rounding or rejection consistently; never silently alter totals.

why_boundary: Malformed currency code is untrusted input
expected_behavior: Reject unsupported currency identifiers as validation errors; do not interpret the value as executable content.

why_boundary: Zero-decimal currency combines with a leap-day expense
expected_behavior: If JPY is supported, preserve its supported precision and include the expense in the February 2024 Travel total.

why_boundary: Three-decimal currency tests precision beyond common two-decimal formats
expected_behavior: If KWD is supported, accept its supported fractional precision; otherwise reject clearly without rounding into a different amount.

why_boundary: Emoji, RTL text, and non-Latin characters test encoding and rendering
expected_behavior: Preserve supported Unicode and display it safely without corrupting note text or category grouping.

why_boundary: Very long optional text may exceed UI or storage limits
expected_behavior: Apply a documented note-length limit; reject excess input clearly or safely truncate only if that is the documented policy.

why_boundary: Leap day is valid in a leap year
expected_behavior: Accept the valid date and include the expense in February 2024.

why_boundary: February 29 is invalid in a non-leap year
expected_behavior: Reject the invalid calendar date; do not add it to a monthly total.

why_boundary: November has no 31st day
expected_behavior: Reject the invalid date; do not silently normalize it into December.

why_boundary: Adjacent month-end dates test monthly grouping
expected_behavior: Keep each expense in its date's month; October Food total is 10 USD and November Food total is 20 USD.

why_boundary: Offset timestamp may fall on a different UTC calendar date
expected_behavior: Define policy: suggested default is to assign expenses using the user's entered local calendar date consistently for monthly totals.

why_boundary: Non-finite amount and malformed date test invalid-value handling
expected_behavior: Reject invalid amount and date with clear validation errors; do not persist or aggregate them.

why_boundary: Markup-like and special text test safe text handling
expected_behavior: Treat values strictly as text; safely encode on display and never execute or interpret them.

why_boundary: No history means there is no established average
expected_behavior: Define policy: suggested default is not to flag until an eligible baseline exists; document the averaging window and minimum history.

why_boundary: A zero average makes the ratio undefined or overly sensitive
expected_behavior: Define policy: suggested default is not to flag based on a zero average alone; apply a documented minimum-history rule.

why_boundary: Comparing unlike currencies without conversion gives an invalid ratio
expected_behavior: Compare only matching currencies unless a conversion source and rate date are specified; never compare unlike raw amounts.

why_boundary: Repeated equal entries can be intentional or accidental
expected_behavior: Count each successfully saved expense once; do not silently deduplicate identical records.

input: [1000 valid expenses in one month for the same category and currency]
why_boundary: Burst volume stresses aggregation accuracy and responsiveness
expected_behavior: Process every valid expense without loss or double counting; return an accurate monthly category total.
